title: Backlog file for pnpm backlog:create (scripts/create-backlog.mjs)
description: Milestones and issues by key. Each key is written as the item's marker (<!-- backlog:key <key> -->), so a re-run matches what exists and makes only what is missing; it never rewrites an existing item.

milestones.description: In sprint order: an issue may wait only for issues in its own or an earlier milestone.

title.description: An unmarked milestone whose title starts the same ("Sprint 1 ·") is adopted.

labels.description: Colours and descriptions for labels the issues use; a used label not listed here is made grey.

body.description: Markdown, without the Model and Waits-for lines and the marker: the script writes those (Model from fields.Model, Waits for from waitsFor as issue numbers).

parent.description: The key of the issue (an epic) this one is a sub-issue of.

waitsFor.description: Keys of the issues this one waits for: the Waits-for line and GitHub's blocked-by links. They are made first.

fields.description: Board values, set only where the issue's item has none yet. Status is Backlog unless given.
